message: What are the RDKit-computed properties (molecular weight, logP, TPSA, H-bond donors and acceptors, rotatable bonds) of ibuprofen? Use the appropriate tool.

Run drug-likeness gates on these molecules and tell me which pass a Lipinski-style filter: aspirin (CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O), ibuprofen (CC(C)Cc1ccc(cc1)C(C)C(=O)O), and erythromycin. Use the molecule gates tool.
Convert the SMILES of ibuprofen (CC(C)Cc1ccc(cc1)C(C)C(=O)O) to SAFE fragment notation using the dedicated tool, then convert that SAFE string back to SMILES with the dedicated tool.
Predict the core ADMET panel (including hERG, blood-brain barrier, and aqueous solubility) for aspirin and ibuprofen. Use the ADMET tool.
What is the PDB Chemical Component Dictionary (CCD) code for imatinib?
Search the RCSB PDB for X-ray structures of human carbonic anhydrase 2 and list a few PDB IDs with resolutions.
Download the structure of gefitinib from PubChem, then predict its ADMET properties (hERG and solubility at least). Use the tools.
Fetch and clean the PDB structure 1STP (streptavidin bound to biotin), then profile the protein-ligand interactions between the protein and biotin using PLIP.
Find aspirin's 3D structure on PubChem, download it, and display it in the 3D viewer.
